verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say users can customize, run, print, or export payroll reports. That covers report generation and export for analysis. However, the evidence never names a payroll register or a gross-to-net report, and gives no export formats. missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, documented export formats (e.g. CSV/Excel), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis

citations.quote: You can customize, run, print, or export a payroll report and share valuable insights with your accountant.
